# Derive parser conformance corpus
#
# Format and s-expression notation: PARSER-SPEC.md section 14.
#
#     <input>    =>    <expected>
#
# `[state: ...]` and `[declared: ...]` apply until the next such line or the
# next `##` group header. Text after ` # ` is a comment.
#
# Every case below was confirmed against the original: the tree it builds for
# the input agrees with the expectation here. Error cases are rejected there
# too; their offsets were not machine-checkable and are marked.
#
# Do not edit an expected result to make a test pass.


## Group: Number literals

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
2    =>    2
23    =>    23
0    =>    0
7    =>    7
5^99    =>    (^ 5 99)
54!    =>    (fact 54)
123456789    =>    123456789
2.5    =>    2.5
0.5    =>    0.5
0.1    =>    0.1
0.01    =>    0.01
0.001    =>    0.001
0.00729735308    =>    0.00729735308
453.59237    =>    453.59237
10973731.534    =>    10973731.534
0.577215664901532860606512    =>    0.577215664901532860606512
1.5    =>    1.5
0.25    =>    0.25
0.8    =>    0.8
1/2    =>    (/ 1 2)
1/2 + 1/6    =>    (+ (/ 1 2) (/ 1 6))
2/27    =>    (/ 2 27)
3 1/2    =>    (/ (juxt 3 1) 2)
6.02 * 10^23    =>    (* 6.02 (^ 10 23))
6.6260755*10^(-34)    =>    (* 6.6260755 (^ 10 (neg 34)))
1.60217733*10^(-19)    =>    (* 1.60217733 (^ 10 (neg 19)))
6.0221367*10^23    =>    (* 6.0221367 (^ 10 23))
10^(-6)    =>    (^ 10 (neg 6))
10^12    =>    (^ 10 12)
1.5E7    =>    (juxt 1.5 e 7)
2.325E-7    =>    (- (juxt 2.325 e) 7)
299792458    =>    299792458
370370367    =>    370370367
.5    =>    0.5
12.34.5    =>    ERROR@5    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked
1.0    =>    1    # a radix point is spelling, not value, and so are the zeros around it
1.    =>    1
1.000    =>    1
1.50    =>    1.5
0.10    =>    0.1
12.3450    =>    12.345
100.0    =>    100
0.0    =>    0
.0    =>    0
0.    =>    0
007    =>    7
010    =>    10
00.50    =>    0.5
-1.0    =>    (neg 1)

## Group: Number literals in non-decimal radices

[state: InputBase=16]
2A    =>    42
0E    =>    14
2 A    =>    (juxt 2 a)
E    =>    e
0.1    =>    0.0625    # value confirmed by simplifying 0.1 - (1/10) to zero
1.8    =>    1.5
0FF.0    =>    255
0.123456789ABCDEF    =>    0.071111111111111110182070316199087756103835999965667724609375
[state: InputBase=2]
2    =>    ERROR@0    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked
0.1    =>    0.5
1.1    =>    1.5
0.001    =>    0.125
[state: InputBase=3]
0.1    =>    1/3    # a numeral worth no finite decimal keeps its exact value
0.2    =>    2/3
10.1    =>    10/3
[state: InputBase=10]
2A    =>    (juxt 2 a)

## Group: Identifiers, character mode (default)

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]

y    =>    y

abc    =>    (juxt a b c)
mx    =>    (juxt m x)

BETA    =>    β
velocity    =>    (juxt v e l o c i t y)
x2    =>    (juxt x 2)
x 2    =>    (juxt x 2)
2x    =>    (juxt 2 x)
x_    =>    x_
y__    =>    y__
f__    =>    f__
g__    =>    g__
x_y_    =>    (juxt x_ y_)
c17__    =>    ERROR@3    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked
[declared: var c17__]
c17__    =>    c17__
@1    =>    @1
@2    =>    @2
"any text at all"    =>    "any text at all"
"my var" + 1    =>    (+ "my var" 1)
_foo    =>    ERROR@0    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked

## Group: Case mode

[state: CaseMode=Insensitive]
sin(x)    =>    (call SIN x)
SIN(x)    =>    (call SIN x)
Sin(x)    =>    (call SIN x)
pi    =>    pi
PI    =>    pi
DEG    =>    deg
and    =>    ERROR@0    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked
a and b    =>    (and a b)
IF(DIF(p,x)=0 and DIF(q,y)=0,1,0)    =>    (call IF (and (rel (call DIF p x) = 0) (rel (call DIF q y) = 0)) 1 0)
-COS(3*pi*X/10)*COS(pi*Y/10)    =>    (neg (* (call COS (/ (* 3 pi x) 10)) (call COS (/ (* pi y) 10))))
(abs (x/2))^abs (x/2)    =>    (^ (call ABS (/ x 2)) (call ABS (/ x 2)))
[state: CaseMode=Sensitive]
SIN(x)    =>    (call SIN x)
sin(x)    =>    (juxt s i n x)
X    =>    X
x    =>    x
[state: CaseMode=Sensitive; InputMode=Word]
rPle(e,v,n):=VECTOR(IF(iI=n,e,ELEMENT(v,iI)),iI,DIMENSION(v))    =>    (fundef rPle (params e v n) (call VECTOR (call IF (rel iI = n) e (call ELEMENT v iI)) iI (call DIMENSION v)))
dGt(T,x):=IF(T=0,0,0,x*DIF(T,x)/T)    =>    (fundef dGt (params T x) (call IF (rel T = 0) 0 0 (/ (* x (call DIF T x)) T)))
lInarx(A,r):=IF(r>1,lInarx(APPEND(A),r-1),A)    =>    (fundef lInarx (params A r) (call IF (rel r > 1) (call lInarx (call APPEND A) (- r 1)) A))
lhs-rhs    =>    (- lhs rhs)
InputMode:=Word    =>    (:= InputMode Word)
CaseMode:=Sensitive    =>    (:= CaseMode Sensitive)

δx    =>    δx
[[x-δx,y-r*δx],[x+δx,y+r*δx]]    =>    (vec (vec (- x δx) (- y (* r δx))) (vec (+ x δx) (+ y (* r δx))))

## Group: The `:=` lookahead and declared-name persistence

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
xyz    =>    (juxt x y z)
mx    =>    (juxt m x)
wxyz=1    =>    (rel (juxt w x y z) = 1)
abcd:=5    =>    (:= abcd 5)
[declared: var abcd]
abcd    =>    abcd
abcd+1    =>    (+ abcd 1)
tera:=10^12    =>    (:= tera (^ 10 12))
[declared: var tera]
terab    =>    (juxt tera b)
tera    =>    tera
teraxyz    =>    (juxt tera x y z)
FIT3(mx,mf):=mx+mf    =>    (fundef FIT3 (params mx mf) (+ mx mf))
[declared: fun FIT3/2; var mx; var mf]
mx+mf    =>    (+ mx mf)
mx    =>    mx
quux(z)    =>    (juxt q u u x z)
gh(p,q):=    =>    (fundef GH (params p q))
[declared: fun GH/2; var p; var q]
gh(1,2)    =>    (call GH 1 2)
default1:=1    =>    (:= default1 1)
[declared: var default1]
default1    =>    default1
euler_gamma    =>    euler_gamma
unit_circle    =>    unit_circle

## Group: Implicit multiplication (§4.3 in full, plus more)

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
2x    =>    (juxt 2 x)
x 2    =>    (juxt x 2)
2 3    =>    (juxt 2 3)
23    =>    23
xyz    =>    (juxt x y z)
x y z    =>    (juxt x y z)
x_ y_    =>    (juxt x_ y_)
sin(x+1)    =>    (call SIN (+ x 1))
SIN x    =>    (apply SIN x)
x(x+1)    =>    (juxt x (+ x 1))
2(x+1)    =>    (juxt 2 (+ x 1))
2 (3 + 5)    =>    (juxt 2 (+ 3 5))
(x+1)(x-1)    =>    (juxt (+ x 1) (- x 1))
(x^2-y^2)^5(2 x^2 - 3)    =>    (juxt (^ (- (^ x 2) (^ y 2)) 5) (- (juxt 2 (^ x 2)) 3))
x^2(x+1)    =>    (juxt (^ x 2) (+ x 1))
p^2-4q    =>    (- (^ p 2) (juxt 4 q))
a a^x    =>    (juxt a (^ a x))
2x(y+1)+y    =>    (+ (juxt 2 x (+ y 1)) y)
2 3^2    =>    (juxt 2 (^ 3 2))
3pi    =>    (juxt 3 pi)
2 #i    =>    (juxt 2 #i)
(1 + 2 #i) (3 + #i)    =>    (juxt (+ 1 (juxt 2 #i)) (+ 3 #i))
4/3 #i    =>    (juxt (/ 4 3) #i)
-30 DEG    =>    (neg (juxt 30 deg))
17/6 pi    =>    (juxt (/ 17 6) pi)
x y    =>    (juxt x y)
x^2 y^3    =>    (juxt (^ x 2) (^ y 3))
2 k    =>    (juxt 2 k)
10h    =>    (juxt 10 h)
3 y CSC(x)    =>    (juxt 3 y (call CSC x))
3 sin t    =>    (juxt 3 (apply SIN t))
2 SIN LN ABS x    =>    (juxt 2 (apply SIN (apply LN (apply ABS x))))
CSC (2x) (2 (COS (x/2))^2 - 1)    =>    (juxt (call CSC (juxt 2 x)) (- (juxt 2 (^ (call COS (/ x 2)) 2)) 1))
1.5 pi/2    =>    (/ (juxt 1.5 pi) 2)
3 [2·x, -5, x^2]    =>    (juxt 3 (vec (* 2 x) (neg 5) (^ x 2)))
2 |x|    =>    (juxt 2 (abs x))
2 ?    =>    (juxt 2 ?)
2 "name"    =>    (juxt 2 "name")
(a)(b)(c)    =>    (juxt a b c)
2*3 4    =>    (prod 2 * 3 juxt 4)
2 3*4    =>    (prod 2 juxt 3 * 4)
a/b c    =>    (juxt (/ a b) c)
a b/c    =>    (/ (juxt a b) c)
r LIM(h,x,x+1)    =>    (juxt r (call LIM h x (+ x 1)))
x SUB 2 y    =>    (juxt (sub x 2) y)
2 -3    =>    (- 2 3)
2(-3)    =>    (juxt 2 (neg 3))
h_ n_    =>    (juxt h_ n_)

## Group: Precedence and associativity

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
1 / 2 * 3    =>    (* (/ 1 2) 3)
2 + 3 * 4    =>    (+ 2 (* 3 4))
a - b - c    =>    (- a b c)
a / b / c    =>    (/ (/ a b) c)
a + b - c + d    =>    (sum a + b - c + d)
a * b / c * d    =>    (* (/ (* a b) c) d)
a - b * c    =>    (- a (* b c))
a^b^c    =>    (^ a (^ b c))
4^3^2    =>    (^ 4 (^ 3 2))
2^3^2    =>    (^ 2 (^ 3 2))
x^2^3^4    =>    (^ x (^ 2 (^ 3 4)))
2^-3    =>    (^ 2 (neg 3))
2^-k    =>    (^ 2 (neg k))
2^-3^2    =>    (^ 2 (neg (^ 3 2)))
9^1/3    =>    (/ (^ 9 1) 3)
9^(1/3)    =>    (^ 9 (/ 1 3))
-x^2    =>    (neg (^ x 2))
(-x)^2    =>    (^ (neg x) 2)
-x*y    =>    (neg (* x y))
-p/q    =>    (neg (/ p q))
-t_/2    =>    (neg (/ t_ 2))
- 1 / SQRT 2    =>    (neg (/ 1 (apply SQRT 2)))
- 1/2    =>    (neg (/ 1 2))
a . b    =>    (dot a b)
a.b    =>    (dot a b)
a . b + c    =>    (+ (dot a b) c)
a * b . c    =>    (dot (* a b) c)
a . b . c    =>    (dot (dot a b) c)
c . h + p    =>    (+ (dot c h) p)
v SUB 1^2    =>    (^ (sub v 1) 2)
v SUB 1 + v SUB 2    =>    (+ (sub v 1) (sub v 2))
a SUB i+1    =>    (+ (sub a i) 1)
a SUB (i+1)    =>    (sub a (+ i 1))
x^v SUB 1    =>    (^ x (sub v 1))
a SUB k SUB 1    =>    (sub (sub a k) 1)
n!    =>    (fact n)
n!!    =>    (fact (fact n))
(1/2) !    =>    (fact (/ 1 2))
(- 1/2) !    =>    (fact (neg (/ 1 2)))
(n+2)!/(n-1)!    =>    (/ (fact (+ n 2)) (fact (- n 1)))
n_*n_!    =>    (* n_ (fact n_))
2^3!    =>    (^ 2 (fact 3))
-3!    =>    (neg (fact 3))
5%    =>    (pct 5)
22% + 36%    =>    (+ (pct 22) (pct 36))
10%/12    =>    (/ (pct 10) 12)
2^3%    =>    (^ 2 (pct 3))
5%!    =>    (fact (pct 5))
a`    =>    (transpose a)
a``    =>    (transpose (transpose a))
a` . a    =>    (dot (transpose a) a)
(b` . a`)`    =>    (transpose (dot (transpose b) (transpose a)))
a`!    =>    (fact (transpose a))
a` SUB 3    =>    (sub (transpose a) 3)
2 + 3 = 5    =>    (rel (+ 2 3) = 5)
a = b AND c = d    =>    (and (rel a = b) (rel c = d))
NOT a = b    =>    (not (rel a = b))
a AND b OR c    =>    (or (and a b) c)
a := b + 1    =>    (:= a (+ b 1))

## Group: Unary operators

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]

+x    =>    (pos x)
--x    =>    (neg (neg x))
-(-1)    =>    (neg (neg 1))
- -3    =>    (neg (neg 3))
2 - -3    =>    (- 2 (neg 3))
-1    =>    (neg 1)
-inf    =>    (neg inf)
-b    =>    (neg b)
-2*x    =>    (neg (* 2 x))
"+-" x    =>    (pm x)
"+-" inf    =>    (pm inf)
"+-" 1    =>    (pm 1)
±x    =>    (pm x)
-SQRT ABS COT (0.8 x)    =>    (neg (apply SQRT (apply ABS (call COT (juxt 0.8 x)))))
SIGN -3    =>    (apply SIGN (neg 3))
- COS (2*t) - COS t    =>    (- (neg (call COS (* 2 t))) (apply COS t))

## Group: Parenthesised calls

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
SIN(x)    =>    (call SIN x)
SIN (x)    =>    (call SIN x)
LIM(u,x,a)    =>    (call LIM u x a)
LIM (u, x, a)    =>    (call LIM u x a)
LOG (10^3, 10)    =>    (call LOG (^ 10 3) 10)
DIF(u,x)    =>    (call DIF u x)
DIF(u,x,n)    =>    (call DIF u x n)
DIF(u,x,-1)    =>    (call DIF u x (neg 1))
APPROX(u)    =>    (call APPROX u)
APPROX(u,10)    =>    (call APPROX u 10)
CHI(a,x,b)    =>    (call CHI a x b)
FLOOR(m)    =>    (call FLOOR m)
FLOOR(m,n)    =>    (call FLOOR m n)
GCD(a,b,c,d)    =>    (call GCD a b c d)
MIN([1,2,3])    =>    (call MIN (vec 1 2 3))
RMS ([2, 3, 5])    =>    (call RMS (vec 2 3 5))
AVERAGE (x, y, z)    =>    (call AVERAGE x y z)
ATAN (-1, -1)    =>    (call ATAN (neg 1) (neg 1))
PERM (m, n)    =>    (call PERM m n)
PMT (10%/12, 2*12, 12000)    =>    (call PMT (/ (pct 10) 12) (* 2 12) 12000)
FACTOR(SIDE(w),Trivial,a)    =>    (call FACTOR (call SIDE w) Trivial a)
[declared: fun FACTORED/5; var w; var x; var y; var y1; var y2]
FACTOR(w,Rational,y2)    =>    (call FACTOR w Rational y2)
[declared: fun ACCELERATION/2]
ACCELERATION(6)    =>    (call ACCELERATION 6)
f(x)    =>    (juxt f x)
quux(z)    =>    (juxt q u u x z)
f(x,y)    =>    ERROR@6    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked
f(x,y):=x+y    =>    (fundef F (params x y) (+ x y))
SIN[x]    =>    (apply SIN (vec x))
SIN{x}    =>    ERROR@3    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked

## Group: The derivative prime

[state: InputMode=Word; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
[declared: fun BB/1; fun CC/2]
BB'(r)    =>    (call BB' r)
BB''(r)    =>    (call BB'' r)
BB'''(r)    =>    (call BB''' r)
BB'(r^2)    =>    (call BB' (^ r 2))
2BB'(r)    =>    (juxt 2 (call BB' r))
CC'(u, v)    =>    (call CC' u v)
DIF(BB'(r), r)    =>    (call DIF (call BB' r) r)
INT(BB'(r), r)    =>    (call INT (call BB' r) r)

## Group: Bare (parenthesis-free) application

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
SQRT 9    =>    (apply SQRT 9)
LN 1    =>    (apply LN 1)
LOG x    =>    (apply LOG x)
LN 6 - LN 2    =>    (- (apply LN 6) (apply LN 2))
LN 16 / LN 8    =>    (/ (apply LN 16) (apply LN 8))
EXP LN x    =>    (apply EXP (apply LN x))
LN EXP x    =>    (apply LN (apply EXP x))
SIGN 5    =>    (apply SIGN 5)
SIGN -3    =>    (apply SIGN (neg 3))
SIGN SIGN z    =>    (apply SIGN (apply SIGN z))
SIGN ATAN x    =>    (apply SIGN (apply ATAN x))
SIGN LN (1 + COS x)    =>    (apply SIGN (call LN (+ 1 (apply COS x))))
COS ABS x    =>    (apply COS (apply ABS x))
ABS x / SIGN x    =>    (/ (apply ABS x) (apply SIGN x))
ABS z SIGN z    =>    (juxt (apply ABS z) (apply SIGN z))
SQRT (4 - 2 * SQRT (3))    =>    (call SQRT (- 4 (* 2 (call SQRT 3))))
SQRT (5 + SQRT 24) + SQRT (5 - SQRT 24)    =>    (+ (call SQRT (+ 5 (apply SQRT 24))) (call SQRT (- 5 (apply SQRT 24))))
SQRT (-1)    =>    (call SQRT (neg 1))
COS (17/6 pi)    =>    (call COS (juxt (/ 17 6) pi))
SIN (-30 DEG)    =>    (call SIN (neg (juxt 30 deg)))
(SIN x)^3 + SIN x + (COS x)^2 SIN x    =>    (+ (^ (apply SIN x) 3) (apply SIN x) (juxt (^ (apply COS x) 2) (apply SIN x)))
TAN ATAN x    =>    (apply TAN (apply ATAN x))
CSC ACSC x    =>    (apply CSC (apply ACSC x))
ACOT t + ATAN t    =>    (+ (apply ACOT t) (apply ATAN t))
LIM (SIN x / x, x, 0)    =>    (call LIM (/ (apply SIN x) x) x 0)
TAYLOR (LN COS (a x), x, 0, 7)    =>    (call TAYLOR (apply LN (call COS (juxt a x))) x 0 7)
INT (COS x, x)    =>    (call INT (apply COS x) x)
INT (1/SQRT x, x, 0, b^2)    =>    (call INT (/ 1 (apply SQRT x)) x 0 (^ b 2))
DET [[1, a, a, a], [1, x, a, a], [1, a, x, a], [1, a, a, x]]    =>    (apply DET (vec (vec 1 a a a) (vec 1 x a a) (vec 1 a x a) (vec 1 a a x)))
2 SQRT ABS SIN x    =>    (juxt 2 (apply SQRT (apply ABS (apply SIN x))))
3 SECH SEC x    =>    (juxt 3 (apply SECH (apply SEC x)))
2 CSCH SEC x    =>    (juxt 2 (apply CSCH (apply SEC x)))
SEC SIN x    =>    (apply SEC (apply SIN x))
TAN COS x    =>    (apply TAN (apply COS x))
ATAN TAN x    =>    (apply ATAN (apply TAN x))
ASIN SIN x    =>    (apply ASIN (apply SIN x))
COTH SEC x + TANH SEC x    =>    (+ (apply COTH (apply SEC x)) (apply TANH (apply SEC x)))
SIGN COS x    =>    (apply SIGN (apply COS x))
ASIN ATAN (0.4 * x)    =>    (apply ASIN (call ATAN (* 0.4 x)))
SIN x^2    =>    (^ (apply SIN x) 2)
(SIN x)^2    =>    (^ (apply SIN x) 2)
SIN x SUB 1    =>    (apply SIN (sub x 1))
SIN x + 1    =>    (+ (apply SIN x) 1)
SIN x * y    =>    (* (apply SIN x) y)
SIN x y    =>    (juxt (apply SIN x) y)

## Group: Power of a function

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
SQRT^3 25    =>    (funcpow SQRT 3 25)
SIN^2 x    =>    (funcpow SIN 2 x)
SIN^2 (x)    =>    (funcpow SIN 2 x)
LN^2 x    =>    (funcpow LN 2 x)
SIN^n x    =>    (funcpow SIN n x)
SQRT^3 25 + 1    =>    (+ (funcpow SQRT 3 25) 1)

## Group: Vectors, matrices, nesting

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
[a,b,c]    =>    (vec a b c)
[a, b, c]    =>    (vec a b c)
[2·x, -5, x^2]    =>    (vec (* 2 x) (neg 5) (^ x 2))
[]    =>    (vec)
[[]]    =>    (vec (vec))
[[4, a, -5], [a^2, 5, 8·a^2]]    =>    (vec (vec 4 a (neg 5)) (vec (^ a 2) 5 (* 8 (^ a 2))))
[[a,b,c],[1,2,3]]    =>    (vec (vec a b c) (vec 1 2 3))
[1,0,0]    =>    (vec 1 0 0)
[[-t_,-t_/2],[t_,-t_/2],[0,t_]]    =>    (vec (vec (neg t_) (neg (/ t_ 2))) (vec t_ (neg (/ t_ 2))) (vec 0 t_))
[[x,y],[[x,y],[x,y]+w]]    =>    (vec (vec x y) (vec (vec x y) (+ (vec x y) w)))
[[r,theta,z],[1,r,1]]    =>    (vec (vec r θ z) (vec 1 r 1))
[[r,theta,phi],[1,r*SIN(phi),r]]    =>    (vec (vec r θ φ) (vec 1 (* r (call SIN φ)) r))
2*[[a,2],[3,b]]+[[1,3],[a,-b]]    =>    (+ (* 2 (vec (vec a 2) (vec 3 b))) (vec (vec 1 3) (vec a (neg b))))
[2,a,5] . [2*a,3,-1]    =>    (dot (vec 2 a 5) (vec (* 2 a) 3 (neg 1)))
[2, a, 5].[2*a, 3, -1]    =>    (dot (vec 2 a 5) (vec (* 2 a) 3 (neg 1)))
[[a,b],[c,d]] . [[x],[y]]    =>    (dot (vec (vec a b) (vec c d)) (vec (vec x) (vec y)))
[[a,b],[2,3]]^(-1)    =>    (^ (vec (vec a b) (vec 2 3)) (neg 1))
[[a,b,c],[1,2,3]]`    =>    (transpose (vec (vec a b c) (vec 1 2 3)))
[t * (t^2 - 1) / (t^2 + 1), 2 * (t^2 - 1) / (t^2 + 1)]    =>    (vec (/ (* t (- (^ t 2) 1)) (+ (^ t 2) 1)) (/ (* 2 (- (^ t 2) 1)) (+ (^ t 2) 1)))
[3 sin t, 2 sin (2*t)]    =>    (vec (juxt 3 (apply SIN t)) (juxt 2 (call SIN (* 2 t))))
[1,2,]    =>    ERROR@5    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked
[1,2    =>    ERROR@4    # rejection confirmed; offset not machine-checked
[a]    =>    (vec a)
[w]    =>    (vec w)

## Group: `SUB` chains and vector indices

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
x SUB 2    =>    (sub x 2)
m SUB 2 SUB 3    =>    (sub (sub m 2) 3)
[[a,b,c],[1,2,3]] SUB 1 SUB 2    =>    (sub (sub (vec (vec a b c) (vec 1 2 3)) 1) 2)
[[a,b,c],[1,2,3]] SUB 2    =>    (sub (vec (vec a b c) (vec 1 2 3)) 2)
[[a,b,c],[1,2,3]]` SUB 3    =>    (sub (transpose (vec (vec a b c) (vec 1 2 3))) 3)
[[2, 3, 5], [7, 1, 4]] SUB [2, 3]    =>    (sub (vec (vec 2 3 5) (vec 7 1 4)) (vec 2 3))
a SUB (m_-1)    =>    (sub a (- m_ 1))
a SUB (i+1)*x^i    =>    (* (sub a (+ i 1)) (^ x i))
a SUB m_ SUB 1    =>    (sub (sub a m_) 1)
-a SUB 1    =>    (neg (sub a 1))
a SUB m_-a SUB m_ SUB j/a SUB i SUB j*a SUB i    =>    (- (sub a m_) (* (/ (sub (sub a m_) j) (sub (sub a i) j)) (sub a i)))
v SUB 1+2*v SUB 2    =>    (+ (sub v 1) (* 2 (sub v 2)))
(SOLVE(u,x)) SUB 1    =>    (sub (call SOLVE u x) 1)
ELEMENT(v,1)    =>    (call ELEMENT v 1)
ELEMENT([[a, b, c], [1, 2, 3]],1,2)    =>    (call ELEMENT (vec (vec a b c) (vec 1 2 3)) 1 2)
ELEMENT([[a, b, c], [1, 2, 3]]`,3)    =>    (call ELEMENT (transpose (vec (vec a b c) (vec 1 2 3))) 3)
xSUBy    =>    (sub x y)

## Group: Relations and relation chains

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
x = 1    =>    (rel x = 1)
x /= 1    =>    (rel x /= 1)
a < b    =>    (rel a < b)
a <= b    =>    (rel a <= b)
a ≤ b    =>    (rel a <= b)
a > b    =>    (rel a > b)
a >= b    =>    (rel a >= b)
a ≥ b    =>    (rel a >= b)
a+b = c+d    =>    (rel (+ a b) = (+ c d))
1<=a<=b-1    =>    (rel (rel 1 <= a) <= (- b 1))
1<=b-1<a    =>    (rel (rel 1 <= (- b 1)) < a)
a<c<3/2    =>    (rel (rel a < c) < (/ 3 2))
c<=a<=0    =>    (rel (rel c <= a) <= 0)
c>a>0    =>    (rel (rel c > a) > 0)
7 <= y <= 7    =>    (rel (rel 7 <= y) <= 7)
x = y = z    =>    (rel (rel x = y) = z)
v_ SUB 3=v_ SUB 4    =>    (rel (sub v_ 3) = (sub v_ 4))
DIF(q,x)=DIF(p,y)    =>    (rel (call DIF q x) = (call DIF p y))
y=(c+INT(q*#e^INT(p,x),x))/#e^INT(p,x)    =>    (rel y = (/ (+ c (call INT (* q (^ #e (call INT p x))) x)) (^ #e (call INT p x))))
INT(1/q,y)=INT(p,x)+c    =>    (rel (call INT (/ 1 q) y) = (+ (call INT p x) c))
v=[]    =>    (rel v = (vec))
v=[a,b]    =>    (rel v = (vec a b))

## Group: Boolean operators and precedence

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
NOT a    =>    (not a)
NOT NOT a    =>    (not (not a))
NOT a AND b    =>    (and (not a) b)
a AND b    =>    (and a b)
a AND b AND c    =>    (and a (and b c))
a AND b OR c    =>    (or (and a b) c)
a OR b AND c    =>    (or a (and b c))
a OR b XOR c    =>    (xor (or a b) c)
a XOR b IMP c    =>    (imp (xor a b) c)
a IMP b IMP c    =>    (imp (imp a b) c)
a OR b OR c    =>    (or a (or b c))
p AND q    =>    (and p q)
n AND d_    =>    (and n d_)
(n AND d_)=0    =>    (rel (and n d_) = 0)
NOT(FREE(b_,a))    =>    (not (call FREE b_ a))
a ≤ b AND b ≤ c OR a ≥ b AND b ≥ c    =>    (or (and (rel a <= b) (rel b <= c)) (and (rel a >= b) (rel b >= c)))
a=b OR a=c OR b=c    =>    (or (rel a = b) (or (rel a = c) (rel b = c)))
n>=0 AND FLOOR(n)=n    =>    (and (rel n >= 0) (rel (call FLOOR n) = n))
m_=1 OR m_=DIMENSION(v)    =>    (or (rel m_ = 1) (rel m_ = (call DIMENSION v)))
v SUB n=e OR n<1    =>    (or (rel (sub v n) = e) (rel n < 1))
MOD(a-1/2)=0 AND (MOD(b)=0 AND (b>=1 AND (MOD(c-1/2)=0 AND NOT(a<c<3/2))))    =>    (and (rel (call MOD (- a (/ 1 2))) = 0) (and (rel (call MOD b) = 0) (and (rel b >= 1) (and (rel (call MOD (- c (/ 1 2))) = 0) (not (rel (rel a < c) < (/ 3 2)))))))
TRUTH_TABLE(p,q,p AND q)    =>    (call TRUTH_TABLE p q (and p q))
true    =>    true
false    =>    false
IF(x,true,false)    =>    (call IF x true false)

[X(r):=,Y(r):=]    =>    (vec (fundef X (params r)) (fundef Y (params r)))

[default1:=1,default1a:=1]    =>    (vec (:= default1 1) (:= default1a 1))

## Group: Special forms

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
IF(x>0,1)    =>    (call IF (rel x > 0) 1)

IF(a=b OR a=c OR b=c, "Isosceles", "Scalene")    =>    (call IF (or (rel a = b) (or (rel a = c) (rel b = c))) "Isosceles" "Scalene")

IF(v=[] OR (v=[a] OR (v=[b] OR (v=[a,b] OR v=[b,a]))),true,false,false)    =>    (call IF (or (rel v = (vec)) (or (rel v = (vec a)) (or (rel v = (vec b)) (or (rel v = (vec a b)) (rel v = (vec b a)))))) true false false)
IF(DIMENSION(SELECT(x=g__,g__,VARIABLES(u)))=1,POLES_6(u,x),[],[])    =>    (call IF (rel (call DIMENSION (call SELECT (rel x = g__) g__ (call VARIABLES u))) = 1) (call POLES_6 u x) (vec) (vec))
VECTOR(u,k,n)    =>    (call VECTOR u k n)
VECTOR(u,k,m,n)    =>    (call VECTOR u k m n)
VECTOR(u,k,m,n,s)    =>    (call VECTOR u k m n s)

VECTOR([x,x^2,x^3],x,1,8)    =>    (call VECTOR (vec x (^ x 2) (^ x 3)) x 1 8)
VECTOR(m_ SUB k SUB 1,k,DIMENSION(m_),1,-1)    =>    (call VECTOR (sub (sub m_ k) 1) k (call DIMENSION m_) 1 (neg 1))
VECTOR(VECTOR(u_ SUB n_,u_,v),n_,DIMENSION(v SUB 1))    =>    (call VECTOR (call VECTOR (sub u_ n_) u_ v) n_ (call DIMENSION (sub v 1)))
SUM(u,n)    =>    (call SUM u n)
SUM(u,n,k,m)    =>    (call SUM u n k m)
SUM([1,2,3])    =>    (call SUM (vec 1 2 3))
SUM (k, k, 0, n)    =>    (call SUM k k 0 n)
SUM (2^-k, k, 0, inf)    =>    (call SUM (^ 2 (neg k)) k 0 inf)
SUM (k/370370367, k, -123456788, 123456789)    =>    (call SUM (/ k 370370367) k (neg 123456788) 123456789)
PRODUCT (2 k, k, 1, n)    =>    (call PRODUCT (juxt 2 k) k 1 n)
ITERATE(u,x,x,-1)    =>    (call ITERATE u x x (neg 1))
LIM(u,x)    =>    (call LIM u x)
LIM(u,x,a)    =>    (call LIM u x a)
LIM(u,x,a,-1)    =>    (call LIM u x a (neg 1))
LIM (1/x, x, 0, -1)    =>    (call LIM (/ 1 x) x 0 (neg 1))
LIM(x^2 + y^2, [x, y], [2, 3])    =>    (call LIM (+ (^ x 2) (^ y 2)) (vec x y) (vec 2 3))
LIM (((x + h)^3 - x^3) / h, h, 0)    =>    (call LIM (/ (- (^ (+ x h) 3) (^ x 3)) h) h 0)
LIM (x^(1/x), x, inf)    =>    (call LIM (^ x (/ 1 x)) x inf)
DIF (x^3, x)    =>    (call DIF (^ x 3) x)
DIF (SIN (x^3), x)    =>    (call DIF (call SIN (^ x 3)) x)
DIF (x^2 y^3, y)    =>    (call DIF (juxt (^ x 2) (^ y 3)) y)
INT (x^2, x)    =>    (call INT (^ x 2) x)
INT (x^2, x, a, b)    =>    (call INT (^ x 2) x a b)
INT (1/x^2, x, a^2, inf)    =>    (call INT (/ 1 (^ x 2)) x (^ a 2) inf)
INT (x^2 COS (a x^3 + b), x)    =>    (call INT (juxt (^ x 2) (call COS (+ (juxt a (^ x 3)) b))) x)
INT (INT (x y, y, 0, SQRT (r^2 - x^2)), x, 0, r)    =>    (call INT (call INT (juxt x y) y 0 (call SQRT (- (^ r 2) (^ x 2)))) x 0 r)
TAYLOR (#e^x, x, 0, 5)    =>    (call TAYLOR (^ #e x) x 0 5)
SELECT(u,k,v)    =>    (call SELECT u k v)
SELECT(x=a_,a_,VARIABLES(u))    =>    (call SELECT (rel x = a_) a_ (call VARIABLES u))
SOLVE(u=0,x)    =>    (call SOLVE (rel u = 0) x)
SOLVE([u=0,v=0],[x,y])    =>    (call SOLVE (vec (rel u = 0) (rel v = 0)) (vec x y))
EXPAND(u)    =>    (call EXPAND u)
EXPAND(t,x)    =>    (call EXPAND t x)
FACTOR(u)    =>    (call FACTOR u)
FACTOR(f,Trivial)    =>    (call FACTOR f Trivial)
IDENTITY_MATRIX(3)    =>    (call IDENTITY_MATRIX 3)
CROSS([1,2,3],[a,b,c])    =>    (call CROSS (vec 1 2 3) (vec a b c))
CHARPOLY([[a,b],[b,a]],z)    =>    (call CHARPOLY (vec (vec a b) (vec b a)) z)
ROW_REDUCE([[2,4],[3,6]],[[6],[9]])    =>    (call ROW_REDUCE (vec (vec 2 4) (vec 3 6)) (vec (vec 6) (vec 9)))

## Group: Hard cases (real corpus lines, in full)

## Precedence note on the interior `:=`

[state: InputMode=Character; CaseMode=Insensitive; InputBase=10]
a = b := c    =>    (rel a = (:= b c))
